description: Side-by-side comparison of a vibrant coral reef with fish and a bleached reef caused by environmental stress.
A vibrant and biodiverse healthy reef featuring a dense explosion of colorful corals surrounded by numerous tropical fish in clear blue water.
Microscopic view of translucent coral polyps with visible brown zooxanthellae algae living inside their tissues.
Brownish-colored branching coral in a deep blue ocean setting.
A tropical island lined with palm trees above the surface and a reef ecosystem in the water.
A brain coral resting among other corals.
A scuba diver by an underwater reef landscape.
A split-screen contrasting a vibrant reef with a field of bleached coral skeletons.
A diver carefully planting a staghorn coral fragment onto the seafloor as part of a reef restoration project.
